encounters.weakness: Tectonic Staff (a seismic pulse from the player's weapon disrupts the spitter's corrosive spittle formation and causes it to retreat or explode into harmless gas).
Crystallized Geode (when held, the geode emits a harmonic frequency that disorients and destabilizes the Wraith's sediment form, causing it to dissolve into harmless dust).
Tectonic Pulse Core (when the Pulse Core is charged and launched as a powerful seismic wave. When activated, it triggers a short earthquake, causing nearby enemies to retreat or be disabled.)
Beastmaster Summon (Turtle Shell) — when the player summons the Turtle Shell, the Guppy is stunned and cannot attack for 3 seconds
Coral Bloom pickup — when the player uses the Coral Bloom, the Manta freezes in place and becomes vulnerable to damage for 4 seconds

Coral Bloom pickup (must be used during the fight — activates a slow pulse that weakens the guardian's defense and allows the player's summoned jellyfish to attack from a distance). When the Coral Bloom is active, the jellyfish form a glowing barrier and deliver damage in waves, reducing guardian health by 15% per second while the bloom pulses.
Player's initial weapon (Bone Dagger) — when swung directly at it, it takes triple damage and shudders.
Flicker Shard — if used to illuminate a point, the enemy becomes vulnerable to necromantic blast attacks for 3 seconds (50% damage).
Soul Shard (obtained in Encounter 2).
Shattered Tempest (when the blade is used in a direct lightning strike, it temporarily disables the enemy's pressure absorption for 3 seconds).
Frost Veil (when active, the wraith's lightning attacks are reflected and redirected into a blast of cold energy, dealing 2x damage to it).

Frost Veil (only active during the final lightning strike — it must be used in proximity). The attack is amplified by ambient pressure, so Frost Veil must be used just before the attack to reflect it.

Shadowblade Blade (player weapon). The blade's darkness causes the Gloamfish to contract and retreat. Using the blade in melee or casting a shadow-slash causes 30% damage increase and 25% chance to stun the enemy.

Sundered Light Fragment (pickup from Encounter 1). The Miremaw is repelled by the fragment's pulse. Using the fragment during combat causes the enemy to recoil and lose 20% HP (50% chance to trigger a 10-second stagger).

Shadow-Weave Cloak (pickup from Encounter 2). The creature is vulnerable to stealth-based attacks when the cloak is active. Using the cloak during combat causes it to shudder and lose 30% HP (and has 40% chance to trigger a 3-second freeze).

Pyromancer's Flame Lance (initial weapon) — if the player uses the Flame Lance in a rapid burst (3 consecutive attacks), the enemy explodes and drops the 'Magma Siphon' pickup (a blue glowing orb that can be used to create temporary flame shields).

Magma Siphon pickup — if the player uses the Magma Siphon to generate a flame wall and the hydra is within 2 meters, it takes 20% additional damage per second during the 5-second duration of the wall.
Ashen Geyser pickup — the wraith cannot phase through flame. If the player uses Ashen Geyser during an attack, the wraith takes 50% more damage and its fire resistance drops by 40%.
Warden's primary weapon (Stinger Spear). When the Warden uses the Stinger Spear (a weapon that emits a sonic pulse), the Silt Guardian is stunned for 3 seconds and takes 40% extra damage.
The Coral Fragment (acquired from the Silt Guardian). When the player uses the Coral Fragment in their hand, the Wraith shudders and takes 30% extra damage for 4 seconds.

The Coral Fragment (acquired from the Silt Guardian). Must be used in a specific sequence: first, the Coral Fragment must be used to disrupt the Sire's core, then the Warden must hold it near the enemy's chest while using the Sonic Shackle (from previous encounter) to trigger a resonance that causes a 10-second chain reaction.
Illusion Spark (player weapon or ability cast)
Bubble of Light (acquired from prior pickup)
Bubble of Light (acquired in Encounter 2)
Sonic Pulse (player weapon). The Mechano-Croc's mechanical core vibrates when hit with a sonic pulse, causing it to stagger and take 2x damage.
Fang Root (pickup from Encounter 1). If the player places the Fang Root on the ground, it triggers a paralyzing pulse.
Echo Shard (pickup from Encounter 2). Must be used during the Maw's mid-phase transformation when it emits a chaotic sonic pulse.
Ranger's Whisper Bow – when the player fires a normal arrow, it causes a 20% reduction in damage to the Shadow Raccoon. This effect stacks up to 3 times with each successful shot.
Glowing Lotus Seed – when the player holds the seed and uses it as a visual aid, the wasp is stunned for 2 seconds and takes 30% more damage from normal arrows.
Twin-Quiver – when using the Twin-Quiver, the Jaguar takes 25% more damage from every arrow fired, especially from the player's rear attack (a unique move).
Player's 'Serrated Razor' weapon — deals 2x damage when used in quick succession (two attacks within 0.5 seconds).
The 'Cryo-Siphon' pickup — if used during the first 10 seconds of contact, the Wraith staggers and takes 50% more damage.

Cryo-Siphon used immediately upon contact — the Wraith shatters its core and takes 300% more damage. If not used within 1.5 seconds, it enters a defensive state with 30% faster healing and 100% damage resistance until player moves again.
Staff of Stillness (gentle rhythm pulse)
Sunset Feather (must be held and touched to base)
Crystalline Seed (must be planted near enemy)
Necrotic Flame (player weapon). The Ghoul Warden is weak to the player's Necrotic Flame. When hit by it, it shrieks and drops a Cursed Bone Chalice (key pickup).

Necrotic Flame (player weapon). The Vulture is immune to poison, but burns to ashes when exposed to the player's Necrotic Flame. It also emits a shriek that distorts time in the area for 2 seconds when hit, increasing difficulty for follow-up attacks. A second weakness is triggered if the player uses the Cursed Bone Chalice (pickup from previous encounter).

Cursed Bone Chalice (collected from the first encounter) used in a ritual with the Skull Fragment (collected in the second encounter). When both items are used together and the player chants the 'Ebon Resonance' incantation, the Guardian takes 50% damage and for 3 seconds becomes vulnerable to all necromantic attacks.
The player's splash potion (applied in the first encounter). When the player throws a splash potion, the Frog Whisperer drops a glowing green leaf (a pickup).
The Glowing Green Leaf (acquired in Encounter 1). When the player uses the leaf as a bait, the enemy flinches and takes 20% more damage for 1 second.

The Honey-Infused Sip (acquired in Encounter 2). When the player drinks the potion and then attacks, the viper's next strike is weak and fizzles. This is only active after the potion has been consumed and applied to the player's action window (e.g., during a dash or quick attack).
Chrono-Weave (player weapon)
Echo Shard (pickup from Encounter 1)
Static Pulse (pickup from Encounter 2)

The player's cracked Warhammer (used in prior combat). When the Warhammer is swung once (a single, powerful strike), it emits a deep thud that staggers the enemy for 2 seconds and reduces its damage output by 50% for 3 seconds.

The Rage Core Shard must be active and inserted in the Warhammer. During the 'Rage Surge' window (3 seconds after taking any damage), using the Warhammer at full power causes all heads to take 150% damage simultaneously.

The player must wield the Warhammer with the Rage Core Shard *and* hold the Jungle Bone Shard. During the final phase (after Hydra death), when the Warden raises a massive vine, the player can use the combo once to trigger a 300% damage burst to the boss.
